# Codeshine

> The ultimate syntax highlighter — beautiful code, zero compromises

Codeshine is a modern, zero-dependency TypeScript-based syntax highlighter library designed for web applications. It provides production-grade code highlighting with minimal overhead, extensive language support, and first-class framework integration.

## Project Overview

- **Version:** 1.0.1
- **License:** MIT
- **Author:** Ersin KOC
- **Repository:** https://github.com/ersinkoc/codeshine
- **Website:** https://codeshine.oxog.dev
- **Package:** @oxog/codeshine

## Key Features

- **Zero Dependencies** - Pure TypeScript, no external libraries
- **45+ Languages** - Organized in 5 tiers from core to extended
- **14 Themes** - 9 dark, 5 light, including VS Code, GitHub, Dracula, Tokyo Night
- **Framework Support** - React, Vue 3, and Svelte components included
- **Advanced Rendering** - Line numbers, line highlighting, focus mode, diff view, word highlighting
- **Streaming Support** - Progressive rendering for large files
- **Auto Detection** - Automatic language detection with confidence scoring
- **Plugin System** - Extensible with custom transformers
- **CDN Ready** - Available via unpkg/jsdelivr for direct browser use
- **TypeScript Native** - Full type safety with strict mode

## Architecture

The codebase follows a modular architecture with clear separation of concerns:

```
src/
├── core/           # Core highlighting engine (tokenizer, parser, renderer)
├── languages/      # Language definitions organized in 5 tiers
├── themes/         # Theme definitions (dark, light, special)
├── renderers/      # Output renderers (React, Vue, Svelte, HTML)
├── plugins/        # Plugin system with transformer pipeline
├── features/       # Optional features (line numbers)
└── utils/          # Utility functions
```

## Core Components

### Highlighting Pipeline

1. **Input** - Code string + options
2. **Language Resolution** - From string or auto-detect
3. **Tokenization** - Matches patterns, keywords, strings, comments
4. **Parsing** - Flat tokens → Line-based structure
5. **Plugin Processing** - Pre/post transformations
6. **Rendering** - Tokens → HTML with theme colors
7. **Output** - HTML string

### Token Types

keyword, string, number, comment, operator, punctuation, function, variable, class, type, constant, property, attribute, tag, regexp, escape, interpolation, meta, invalid, plain

## API Reference

### Basic Usage

```typescript
import { highlight } from '@oxog/codeshine';

const html = highlight(code, {
  language: 'javascript',
  theme: 'dracula',
  lineNumbers: true,
  highlightLines: [2, 3, '5-7']
});
```

### Reusable Instance

```typescript
import { Codeshine } from '@oxog/codeshine';

const codeshine = new Codeshine({
  theme: 'github-dark',
  lineNumbers: true
});

const html = codeshine.highlight(code, { language: 'typescript' });
```

### React Integration

```typescript
import { CodeBlock, useCodeshine } from '@oxog/codeshine/react';

<CodeBlock code={code} language="javascript" theme="dracula" lineNumbers />

const { highlight, setTheme } = useCodeshine('github-dark');
```

### Streaming Large Files

```typescript
import { highlightStream } from '@oxog/codeshine';

for await (const chunk of highlightStream(largeCode, {
  language: 'javascript',
  chunkSize: 100
})) {
  container.innerHTML += chunk;
}
```

### Auto Detection

```typescript
import { detectLanguage } from '@oxog/codeshine';

const result = detectLanguage(unknownCode);
// { language: 'python', confidence: 0.95 }
```

### Plugin System

```typescript
const codeshine = new Codeshine();
codeshine.use({
  name: 'my-plugin',
  onBeforeHighlight(code, options) { /* ... */ },
  onAfterTokenize(tokens) { /* ... */ },
  onAfterRender(html) { /* ... */ }
});
```

## Configuration Options

### HighlightOptions

| Option | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| language | string | Language identifier |
| autoDetect | boolean | Enable language auto-detection |
| theme | string \| Theme | Theme name or object |
| lineNumbers | boolean | Show line numbers |
| startLine | number | Starting line number |
| highlightLines | LineRange[] | Lines to highlight |
| focusLines | LineRange[] | Lines to focus (dim others) |
| diffLines | object | Diff markers (added, removed, modified) |
| highlightWords | string[] | Words to highlight |
| showLanguageBadge | boolean | Show language badge |
| copyButton | boolean | Show copy button |
| filename | string | Display filename |
| wrapLines | boolean | Enable line wrapping |
| maxHeight | string | Maximum container height |
| collapsible | boolean | Enable collapse/expand |
| tabSize | number | Tab width in spaces |
| transformers | Transformer[] | Custom transformers |

## Language Tiers

- **Tier 1 (Core):** JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, TSX, HTML, CSS, JSON, Markdown
- **Tier 2 (Popular):** Python, Java, C, C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Swift, Kotlin
- **Tier 3 (Web/Config):** Bash, GraphQL, PowerShell, SQL, TOML, XML, YAML
- **Tier 4 (Data):** CSV, Diff, JSON5, Regex
- **Tier 5 (Extended):** Lua, Dockerfile, Perl, R, Scala, Haskell, Elixir, etc.

## File Structure

### Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| src/index.ts | Main export file |
| src/core/engine.ts | Codeshine class for reusable instances |
| src/core/highlighter.ts | Core highlight() function |
| src/core/tokenizer.ts | Hybrid tokenization engine |
| src/core/parser.ts | Token stream parser |
| src/core/renderer.ts | Token to HTML renderer |
| src/core/detector.ts | Language auto-detection |
| src/core/streaming.ts | Large file streaming |
| src/languages/registry.ts | Language registry |
| src/themes/registry.ts | Theme registry |
| src/plugins/transformer.ts | Transformer pipeline |

### Language Definition Structure

```typescript
interface LanguageDefinition {
  name: string;
  aliases?: string[];
  extensions?: string[];
  keywords?: string[];
  typeKeywords?: string[];
  constants?: string[];
  patterns: TokenPattern[];
  strings?: StringDefinition[];
  comments?: CommentDefinition;
  brackets?: BracketPair[];
  embeddedLanguages?: EmbeddedLanguage[];
}
```

### Theme Definition Structure

```typescript
interface Theme {
  name: string;
  type: 'dark' | 'light';
  colors: {
    background: string;
    foreground: string;
    // Token colors
    keyword: string;
    string: string;
    number: string;
    comment: string;
    function: string;
    // ... more token types
  };
  ui?: {
    gutterBackground?: string;
    lineHighlight?: string;
    // ... more UI colors
  };
}
```

## Built-in Transformers

- `lineLinksTransformer` - Adds ID attributes to lines
- `removeCommentsTransformer` - Removes comment tokens
- `normalizeWhitespaceTransformer` - Normalizes whitespace
- `trimTrailingWhitespaceTransformer` - Removes trailing spaces

## Distribution Formats

| Format | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| ESM | dist/esm/index.js | Modern ES modules |
| CJS | dist/cjs/index.js | CommonJS for Node.js |
| Browser ESM | dist/browser/codeshine.esm.min.js | Minified ESM for browsers |
| Browser IIFE | dist/browser/codeshine.iife.min.js | For older browsers |
| Types | dist/types/index.d.ts | TypeScript declarations |

## CDN Usage

```html
<!-- ESM -->
<script type="module">
  import { highlight } from 'https://unpkg.com/@oxog/codeshine/dist/browser/codeshine.esm.min.js';
</script>

<!-- IIFE -->
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@oxog/codeshine/dist/browser/codeshine.iife.min.js"></script>
```

## Development

### Scripts

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| npm run dev | Watch mode tests |
| npm test | Run all tests |
| npm run test:coverage | Coverage report |
| npm run build | Full build |
| npm run lint | ESLint check |
| npm run format | Prettier format |
| npm run benchmark | Performance benchmarks |

### Adding a New Language

1. Create definition in appropriate tier folder
2. Define keywords, patterns, strings, comments, brackets
3. Export from tier index
4. Add to main languages index
5. Write tests
6. Update documentation

### Adding a New Theme

1. Create theme file with token colors and UI colors
2. Export from appropriate theme folder
3. Add to main theme index
4. Add tests
5. Update documentation

## Environment Support

- **Node.js:** 18.0+
- **Browsers:** Chrome 80+, Firefox 80+, Safari 14+, Edge 80+
- **Frameworks:** React 17.0+, Vue 3.0+, Svelte 3.0+

## Bundle Size

- ESM: ~31 KB (gzipped)
- IIFE: ~25 KB (gzipped)
